main_text.p: & ת inter se permutatis. Pahel נָתֵב Idem. Ex Aphel יַנְתֵּב Flare faciet, Psal.147.18.
נָתַז Ch. Diffluere, diffundi: Spargi, dispergi, Deut.1. 44. & Jobi 3.24.
נָתַךְ Aphel אַתִּיךְ & אַתִּיךְ Ch. Fundere, conflare, proprie de Conflatione metallorum dicitur.
מַתְכָּא, מַתַּךְ Ch. Fusio, fusura, fusile, conflatile. Plural. מַתְכָּן, מַתְכַּת, מַתְכָּן Num.33.52. in Onk. & מַתְכּוּת Ibidem in Targ. Jon. & Hierof. quasi à מַתְכּוּרַת.
אַתְכּוּתָא, אַתְכּוּת Ch. Fusio, infusio, fusura.
הַנְּתוּכִין Ch. Cantherii, tigna, 1.Reg.6.9. ה est pro א.
נְתַל Syr. Dare, Idem quod נְתַן & ל & נ inter se permutatis. Hinc & in Targ. אַן תְּתַל Si dederis, Proverb.26.4.7. ex dialecto Syra.
ܢܬܠ Syr. Datum, ܢܬܠܐ ܢܬܝܠܐ Acceptum & datum, ad Philip.4.15.
*נְתַן Ch. Dare, tradere, reddere, ponere, imponere.
מַתָּן, מַתְנָא, מַתָּן, מַתְנָא מַתָּן Chald. Donum, munus: מַתָּן אַגְרָהוֹן דַּצְדְּקָיָא Datio vel donum praemii justorum, Genes. 49.1. Jon. Plur. מַתְנָן, מַתְנָתָא.
נְתִינָיָא, נְתִינִין Ch. Nethinæi; Ministri publici erat, quasi Deditii dicti, Hebr. נְתִינִים.

נְתַף Syr. Impelli, propelli, circumagi. Huc referunt quidam illud ܢܦܠ Ne auferat, ne propellat plenitudo ejus, Matth.9.16. Alii radicem ejus ponunt תוף. Ethpah. Part. ܐܬܢܬܦ Circumaguntur, Jacobi 3.4. Ab Hebræo נָתַף.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee forms are approximated from a small, partly faint scan; vocalisation and several Syriac/Hebrew words are doubtful and should be checked against the original. The large Hebrew headword at lower right is transcribed as printed.
